events.title: 🔴Nepal-Tibet floods live: Death toll passes 580, nearly 2,500 people missing
Nepal: 'Region has hundreds of high-altitude lakes prone to unleashing enormous volumes of water'
events.summary: William Hilderbrandt is pleased to welcome David Fisher, Head of Delegation, Nepal International Federation of Red Cross. The scale of Nepal’s disaster cannot yet be fully measured. Entire communities remain difficult to reach, tens of thousands of people have been affected, and official assessments are only beginning. But the central challenge is already clear: this cannot be treated solely as an immediate humanitarian emergency. What happens to these communities in the years ahead depends heavily on what we do now. Emergency relief must be accompanied from the outset by planning, funding and action for long-term recovery, including rebuilding homes and livelihoods. If that work is postponed until international attention has moved elsewhere, many people may never fully recover. And signs suggest that the speed and destructive force of this extreme natural event could become more frequent.

events.title: Nepali army rescues people trapped in a tunnel after flooding
events.summary: Video shows the Nepali army rescuing people from the Rasuwa Hydropower tunnel after catastrophic flooding struck the region.

events.title: Nepali officials urge people to higher ground amid fresh flood risk
events.summary: Nepali officials urged people to evacuate as a lake formed by a landslide started overflowing, putting at risk areas devastated by floods days earlier. As people moved to higher ground, rescue operations were temporarily talked due to the risk of more flooding but resumed shortly after.

events.title: Who is Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, the man accused of being the mastermind of the 9/11 attacks
events.summary: Over two decades since 9/11, a date has finally been set for Khalid Sheikh Mohammad to go to trial. NBC News' Courtney Kube reports on the alleged mastermind's history and the long pre-trial proceedings.

events.title: Tate brothers ask judge to be released from Miami jail as they fight extradition to U.K.
events.summary: "Manosphere" influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate, who are facing rape and sex trafficking charges, asked a judge in Miami to be released from jail as they fight extradition to the U.K. After Andrew Tate took the witness stand, he denied being a rapist or human trafficker and described the proceedings as his “last chance.”

events.title: Families wait in agony as Nepal floods leave hundreds missing
events.summary: A New York couple traveling to Mount Kailash is among 65 Americans missing after a catastrophic flood along the Nepal-Tibet border.

events.title: Harry and Meghan arrive for ‘extended’ stay in the U.K. six years after royal exit
events.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan arrived back in the U.K.  after six years in California, a source close to the family confirmed to NBC News.

events.title: Hundreds are missing after catastrophic flooding in Nepal wipes out whole towns
events.summary: Flash floods hit Himalayan mountain towns and villages, sweeping away vehicles, bridges and even buildings as people fled in terror.

events.title: Iran vows retaliation after U.S. widens sanctions, fueling fears of escalated war
events.summary: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran has vowed to retaliate against widened U.S. sanctions, saying Washington should “expect an attack” in response.

events.title: CIA director flies unannounced to Moscow to hold talks, source says
events.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe flew to Russia to holds talks in Moscow, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

events.title: As Ukraine’s allies gather for big anniversary, one key backer is absent
events.summary: The lack of visible senior Trump administration participation was the latest sign of how Washington has backed off during a critical juncture for Ukraine.
